title: Finite etale covers and morphisms descend to finite subextensions
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $L/K$ a separable algebraic extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every intermediate field $K\subseteq E\subseteq L$ with $[E:K]<\infty$, put $X_E=X_0\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}E$, and put $X_L=X_0\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Finite etale covers and their morphisms mean [def-galois-categories].

(1) For every finite etale cover $P\to X_L$ there are such a field $E$, a finite etale cover $P_E\to X_E$, and an isomorphism $P_E\times_{X_E}X_L\cong P$ over $X_L$.

(2) If $P_E,Q_E$ are finite etale covers of $X_E$ and $f:P_E\times_{X_E}X_L\to Q_E\times_{X_E}X_L$ is any $X_L$-morphism, there is a finite intermediate field $E'$ containing $E$ and an $X_{E'}$-morphism $f_{E'}:P_E\times_{X_E}X_{E'}\to Q_E\times_{X_E}X_{E'}$ whose base change is $f$.

(3) If two $X_E$-morphisms $f_E,h_E:P_E\to Q_E$ have equal base changes to $X_L$, their base changes to $X_{E'}$ agree for some finite intermediate field $E'$ containing $E$.

source.place: Tag 0BTV, label lemma-limit: equivalence of the filtered colimit of finite-etale cover categories with the cover category of the limit; specialized to X_E over finite intermediate fields of a separable algebraic extension. Objects, morphisms and eventual equality are the explicit meaning of this categorical equivalence.

proof.text: Use the existing proved FiniteIntermediateField construction and isLimitSpecCone in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.IntermediateFieldLimit. The indices are exactly the finite-dimensional intermediate fields, with bottom and compositum supplying nonemptiness and directedness. Algebra.IsSeparable supplies algebraicity. Its explicit ring colimit, followed by preservation of limits by Spec, identifies Spec L with the limit of their spectra.

Define fieldDiagram with object X_E and transition fieldExtensionBaseMap of the inclusion, and fieldCone with vertex X_L and the specified projections. Check diagram and cone equations on both pullback projections. The transitions are pullbacks of the corresponding affine spectrum maps, so are affine. Base change of the separated quasi-compact structure map to an affine field spectrum makes each stage quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

Apply Mathlib isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected to the natural transformation from fieldDiagram to the spectrum diagram given by the second pullback projections. The finite-field indexing category is connected because it is cofiltered (IsCofiltered.isConnected). The cone morphism is the second projection from X_L to Spec L; its compatibility follows from fieldMap_snd. At each index the induced square is cartesian by isPullback_pullback_map. The already proved isLimitSpecCone therefore makes fieldCone limiting, with exactly the prescribed vertex and projections.

Finite etale covers have local finite presentation, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness by the Mathlib instances for etale and finite morphisms. Apply Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation to a cover P, obtaining a finitely presented model p:Y to X_E. Its source is qcqs by the morphism-permanence lemmas. Transport finiteness and etaleness of P to the limit pullback of p through the cartesian-square isomorphism.

Regard p as a morphism from Over.mk p to the identity object over X_E. Its pullback map is p base changed, followed by the inverse of the canonical identity-pullback isomorphism; cancelling that isomorphism identifies the finite and etale predicates. Apply exists_isFinite_baseChange_stage and Etale.exists_stage_of_inverseLimit independently. Choose a common upper bound of their two finite intermediate fields; finiteness and etaleness persist there by base change. Package this base-changed model as a finite etale cover. Pullback pasting and the original model comparison give its isomorphism with P over X_L. This proves clause (1).

For clause (2), compose the given cover morphism with the first projection to Q and apply Scheme.exists_pullback_hom_of_isLimit. Lift the resulting stage morphism and its structure map into the pullback of Q. Use the cartesian-square pasting isomorphisms for the two covers, with their first-projection equations. A private general pullback naturality lemma proves the comparison equation by cancelling the domain isomorphism and checking both projections: the first is the equation supplied by spreading out, and the second is the structure-map equation for cover morphisms.

For clause (3), project the assumed equality of base-changed morphisms to Q, and apply Scheme.exists_pullback_fst_comp_eq_of_isLimit. At the resulting finite field, pullback extensionality proves equality of the cover maps: their first projections agree by spreading out, and their second projections agree because both are over the base.
